verdict.rationale: Skyvern's first-party docs cover every element of the story. It stores logins and integrates with Bitwarden, 1Password and Azure Key Vault. It completes TOTP/authenticator, email, SMS and magic-link 2FA. It explicitly states the browser-driving model receives placeholders rather than secret values. Credentials are also exposed through the API and MCP tools. A community comment about handing over credentials is general worry, not a concrete counter-example. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the vault-backed login and TOTP flows and of the placeholder secret-isolation behavior.
